# TradePulse Nepal

> TradePulse Nepal is an independent public-data project for exploring Nepal foreign-trade statistics. It processes official Department of Customs, Government of Nepal releases into analysis-ready datasets and explanatory reports.

## Primary resources

- [Nepal Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data.html): Current Nepal foreign-trade overview and key statistics.
- [Download Nepal Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data-download.html): Free CSV and Excel datasets from the latest processed Customs release.
- [Nepal Import Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-import-data.html): Import products and product-partner datasets.
- [Nepal Export Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-export-data.html): Export products and product-partner datasets.
- [FY 2083/84 Trade Data](https://tradepulsenepal.com/nepal-trade-data-2083-84.html): Fiscal-year data hub.
- [Shrawan FY 2083/84 Trade Report](https://tradepulsenepal.com/shrawan-2083-84-trade-report.html): Analysis of the first-month FY 2083/84 release.
- [Products](https://tradepulsenepal.com/products.html): Product-level trade analysis.
- [Trade Deficit](https://tradepulsenepal.com/trade-deficit.html): Nepal merchandise trade-deficit analysis.
- [Data Status and Provenance](https://tradepulsenepal.com/status.html): Coverage, processing status, limitations, and provenance.
- [Methodology / About](https://tradepulsenepal.com/about.html): How TradePulse processes and interprets official trade data.

## Current release

Latest processed release: Shrawan FY 2083/84 (mid-July to mid-August 2026).

Headline values:
- Imports: Rs 187.44 billion
- Exports: Rs 38.70 billion
- Merchandise trade deficit: Rs 148.74 billion
- Total merchandise trade: Rs 226.15 billion
- Import/export ratio: 4.84x
- Import growth versus the comparable prior-year period: 31.04%
- Export growth versus the comparable prior-year period: 61.72%
- Trade-deficit growth versus the comparable prior-year period: 24.88%

## Data available

Free CSV and Excel downloads include:
- headline trade summary
- import products by HS code
- export products by HS code
- trade by partner country
- trade by customs office
- import product x partner-country detail
- export product x partner-country detail
- trade by HS chapter

## Provenance and citation

Primary source: Department of Customs, Government of Nepal.
Processing, presentation, and derived analysis: TradePulse Nepal.

TradePulse Nepal should not be represented as the original government publisher of the underlying Customs statistics. When citing a TradePulse dataset or analysis, identify the Department of Customs as the primary source and TradePulse Nepal as the processor/analyst where appropriate.

Canonical site: https://tradepulsenepal.com/
